name: Lolikko Kunoichi Boshi Soukan ~Futago Doujo no Inmitsu~
original_name: ロリっ娘くのいち母子相姦 ～双子童女の淫蜜～
source:
The triumphant return of lolita ninja Sakura!
This time is an incest love triangle!?

Some years after the sexual wars...
Sakura the daughter has now become a mother.
Her son grows up quickly, and is quite a handful.
Amid these days, she has a nightmare - a terrible vision.
When she awakes, her son is gone. She searches
into the next town, chasing glimpses of his figure.
Along the way she discovers two naked girls.
Stricken with sympathy and pity, she saves them, and
after hearing their story, offers to bring them home.

That's when an all new obscene life begins...

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE072561.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
萝莉忍者樱凯旋归来！
这次是乱伦三角恋！？

性战过去数年后……
身为女儿的樱如今已成为母亲。
儿子长得很快，也相当难以应付。
在这些日子里，她做了一个噩梦——可怕的预兆。
醒来时，儿子已经不见。她追逐隐约看见的身影，搜寻到邻镇。
途中，她发现两名裸体少女。
出于同情与怜悯，她救下两人；听完她们的故事后，便提出带她们回家。

一段全新的淫荡生活就此开始……
